tasks.title: Eight-layer free-edge two-layer opening: interface qualification
tasks.instruction: Interface qualification only, not a model benchmark task. The paper is prepared into an eight-layer packet. Open the front two layers on the free-edge half through 90 degrees, then physically unfold the same crease through 90 degrees to return to the packet. Finish. The supplied image is an original static schematic with height exaggerated, not a physically validated diagram.
tasks.source_note: No external author or independent real source. This minimal probe must never be included in model scores.
